title: Nutrition
description: What he eats, by photo or by saying it: each meal with calories, protein, carbs, fat and a 1-5 quality score; the day's balance against targets from his profile, a 0-100 day score, and his weight log with its chart.
whenToUse: He logs a meal, asks his calories or macros, or logs his weight.
name: Nutrition
usage: «I had two eggs and toast» → `log_meal` with his words in `text`; numbers he gives go in the fields. «I weigh 78.4» → `log_weight`. «show my weight» → `show` screen weight. A meal he names (the toast) is `meal_id`.

log_meal.desc: Log a meal he ate: his words (or a photo the card uploaded); estimated into calories and macros, or saved for him to fill if no estimate is possible.
log_meal.how: `text` = his own words, untouched (portions, preparation, brand). `eaten_at` local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` only if he said when. Only if he GAVE numbers: `calories`, `protein_g`, `carbs_g`, `fat_g`, `fiber_g`, `grams`.

payload.text: two fried eggs and a slice of wholegrain toast

retry_meal.desc: Estimate again a meal whose estimate failed, from its saved photo and words.

refine_meal.desc: Add a detail to a logged meal (it was half, it was fried, the brand) and estimate it again; or move it to another time.
refine_meal.how: `text` = only the new detail in his words; `eaten_at` local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` when he corrects the time.

edit_meal.desc: Correct a meal by hand: its name, calories, macros, grams, quality score 1-5 or time.
edit_meal.how: Send only the fields he corrects. A corrected meal counts as done.

delete_meal.desc: Remove a logged meal (it goes to the bin; `restore` brings it back).

log_weight.desc: Log a body measurement: weight in kg, and optionally body fat %, muscle mass kg, waist cm.
log_weight.how: `measured_at` local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` only if he said when. The latest weight becomes his profile weight.

edit_weight.desc: Correct a body measurement already logged (its value or its date).

delete_weight.desc: Remove a body measurement (it goes to the bin; `restore` brings it back).

restore.desc: Bring back the last removed meal or measurement, or the one named by id.

set_profile.desc: Set what his daily targets come from: weight, height, age, sex, goal (gain, lose, maintain), surplus %, protein g per kg, or a fixed calorie or protein target.
set_profile.how: Only the fields he states. `goal`: gain|lose|maintain; `sex`: male|female|unknown. A field sent empty goes back to the formula.

evaluate_week.desc: Evaluate how he has eaten over the last days: a 0-100 score, strengths, issues and up to four small recommendations.

coach_menu.desc: Recommend what to order from photos of a restaurant menu the card uploaded, given what he has eaten today and his targets.

show.desc: Show a screen of the card: today (meals and balance), weight, coach, evaluation or profile; a past day; or one meal's detail.
